zh.title: BAE Systems 新型 F-16 敵我識別設備取得 AIMS 認證
zh.summary: AN/APX-127(V)1 整合詢問與答詢功能，BAE Systems 預計今年開始交付首批 90 套。
body: BAE Systems 於 2026 年 9 月 29 日宣布，供美國空軍 F-16 使用的 AN/APX-127(V)1 敵我識別整合詢問答詢器，已取得美國主管機關 AIMS 認證，符合美國與 NATO 互通標準。
新設備將詢問與答詢功能整合於單一機組，並採開放式系統架構，支援軟體升級及後續任務需求。公司表示，設備亦支援現行加密與資安韌性要求。
相關工作在紐約州 Greenlawn 與德州 Austin 廠區執行。BAE Systems 預期在 2026 年開始交付首批 90 套量產設備；取得認證不等於這批設備已交付完成。

en.title: BAE Systems wins AIMS certification for new F-16 identification system
en.summary: The AN/APX-127(V)1 combines interrogation and transponder functions; first-lot deliveries are expected in 2026.
body: BAE Systems announced on September 29, 2026 that its AN/APX-127(V)1 combined interrogator transponder had received AIMS certification for the U.S. Air Force’s F-16. The certification supports U.S. and NATO interoperability.

The equipment consolidates interrogation and transponder functions in one unit. Its open-system architecture supports software upgrades, while the design addresses current cryptographic and cybersecurity requirements.

Work takes place in Greenlawn, New York, and Austin, Texas. BAE Systems expects to begin delivering the first 90-unit production lot in 2026. Certification does not mean that the lot has already been delivered.

facts.claim: AN/APX-127(V)1 received AIMS certification for U.S. Air Force F-16 announced 2026-09-29.
Combines interrogation and transponder functions; open architecture supports software upgrades.
First 90-unit lot deliveries expected to start in 2026; work at Greenlawn and Austin.
